newsitem.title: UK: UK shares end lower as Dow weakens, pound gains.
newsitem.headline: UK shares end lower as Dow weakens, pound gains.

text.p: UK shares ended lower on Thursday for the first time this weak, unsettled by declines on Wall Street and renewed talk of an imminent UK interest rate rise.

With British Steel and other major overseas earners losing recent gains as sterling rallied, and Glaxo dragging drug stocks lower after in-line profits, the FTSE 100 ended 19.8 points lower to 4,907.5.

Comments from Chancellor (finance minister) Gordon Brown were taken as a signal he planned no intervention to depress the pound, ending five days of declines for the UK currency and sparking talk of a quarter point rate rise next week.
